title: Nests
summary: Packs only come from spawns whose nest stands. Destroy one and that side goes quiet for a while.
text:
Every spawn the packs come from has a **nest**: a mound of chewed rock and resin where they breed. A spawn whose nest is gone sends no packs until the nest grows back, about ten minutes later.

To clear one, send a real army: nests are tough, and a hurt nest lets out swarmers to guard it. Scout Skimmers can find them first.

- Clearing a nest buys breathing room on that side
- Destroying a nest unlocks a line of research in the Precursor branch
- Nest sites scar the land, and wiping nests out harms planet health for good
- Some neighbours are grateful when you clear a nest on their land
